dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped structures with high-contrast dark perimeters and lighter interior regions; perimeter geometry is irregular and non-uniform, with more elongated elliptical shapes observed towards the lateral boundaries.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid low-intensity pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily concentrated in the interstitial spaces between macro-annuli and becoming more dense near the anterior-dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of three prominent mid-dorsal macro-annuli form an obtuse triangle; four smaller dark blobs near the neck transition form a distinct quadrilateral geometric alignment.
